changelog: v1.0.1: Nested ZIP-in-RAR (Ren'Py), Locale Emulator only for KiriKiri/Wolf/RGSS, more reliable Hub matching (RJ/RY-v, no sibling mixups), English folders stay under the Windows path limit, unzipped folders work like RARs, PlayEnglish on English Windows. The v1.0.0 Downloader installs this build from this manifest.
downloader_changelog: Single-file forum drop. Unpacks WebView2 helpers into LocalAppData on first run. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Reads app_manifest.json and downloads the Translator tag listed there (currently translator-v1.0.1).
